entities.name: Jovanka Bončić-Katerinić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovanka Bončić-Katerinić was a Serbian and then Yugoslav architect who worked in the interwar period. Born in Serbia, Bončić-Katerinić was the first woman to obtain an engineering degree in Imperial Germany.
